intent: Capture a privacy-safe structural runtime fingerprint that can be compared across authorized Frida sessions for recognition, drift and stability analysis.

condition_id.semantics: comparability label, not a causal variable

stable_identity: Android/ART build identity when Java is available
token_vazio: kernel LMKD cause without independent evidence
SELinux causal attribution without denial evidence
physical memory pressure without a measured source
clock_context: device elapsed time when Java is available
external_platform_context: allowlisted local-Android getprop values when the controller itself runs on Android
context is external to the target and cannot by itself establish causality
runtime_scope: JAVA_AWARE when Java.available=true and Java/ART identity is observed
NATIVE_ONLY when Java.available=false; Java absence is an observation scope, not a failure
process_instance_context: process instance drift is distinct from platform identity drift
memory_context: selected same-device system memory/PSI context when available

module_surface_key: privacy-bounded recognition surface; not exact file identity
recognition.fingerprint_note: FNV-1a 32-bit values are compact hints only; full structural fields remain authoritative
recognition.module_surface_ambiguity: duplicate module basenames are reported; full paths remain intentionally uncollected
recognition.java_scope_rule: java_available is part of stable identity; java_identity is required only when java_available=true

invariants: platform identity drift, module-surface drift and volatile runtime drift are reported separately
module-surface drift may reflect legitimate lazy loading and is not automatically identity drift
runtime drift is not automatically classified as instability
absence of a source remains TOKEN_VAZIO
a dump is evidence, not a causal claim
the agent never repairs, resumes, patches or mutates the target
observer state and capture duration are evidence dimensions, not invisible implementation details
estimated boot epoch is approximate context, not a trusted clock authority
missing evidence is not equality
a non-atomic capture with module churn is incomparable for module-surface recognition
Frida Cloak-aware introspection may omit instrumentation-owned resources
memory ranges are enumerated once and aggregated by exact returned protection; overlapping permission filters are forbidden
device elapsed time is clock context and does not by itself constitute runtime drift
local platform context is CONTEXT_ONLY and is not target-process identity
Java unavailable != collector failure when java_available=false
JAVA_AWARE and NATIVE_ONLY observations are different stable identity scopes
condition mismatch is incomparable rather than drift
process restart/generation drift != platform identity drift
boot-session drift != runtime bug
PSS is contextual and may vary with shared-memory attribution

file_contract.atomic_publication: temp + fsync + exclusive hard-link + directory fsync
file_contract.chain_semantics: local append-order integrity only; never causal proof
